description: Unified AI Model Access ApiFlux serves as a multi-protocol AI router designed to simplify the integration of leading large language models. By providing native support for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini APIs, it allows developers to access over 100 different models through a single unified key. This approach eliminates the complexity of managing multiple provider accounts and credentials.
